_note: Seed fields for the four-in-one-nest hunt. All counts numerical unless stated. Coefficient order for 'vec12': P:1,x,y,x^2,xy,y^2 ; Q:1,x,y,x^2,xy,y^2 (xdot=P, ydot=Q).

cherkas_artes_llibre_2003.normal_form: xdot = 1 + x*y ; ydot = a00 + a10*x + a20*x^2 + a01*y + a11*x*y + a*y^2 ; a00 = a01 + a11 - a10 - a20 - a ; focus A=(1,-1) ; a11 is a rotating parameter ; cycles cross the section y=-1 at the listed x values ; counts PROVED exact via Dulac-Cherkas functions in the paper (papers/cherkas2003.pdf)
cherkas_artes_llibre_2003.third_order_weak_focus_family: a11 = 4 - 2a (a != 2), a01 = 2a + 1 - a11, a10 = (6(a^2 - a - 2) + a20(6a - 7))/(1 - 3a), with (a - 3 - a20)/(1 - 3a) < 0 ; 2-parameter family (a, a20) ; focal values V3,V5,V7 given in paper eq.(15)

perko_1984_P3_normal_size_31.system: xdot = P cos(alpha) - Q sin(alpha) ; ydot = P sin(alpha) + Q cos(alpha) ; P = lam*x - y - 10x^2 + (5+delta)xy + y^2 ; Q = x + x^2 + (8eps - 25 - 9delta)xy
